items.title: EXCLUSIVE: Supreme Court Justice Sandeep Mehta asks CJI Surya Kant to replace Rajasthan HC Acting Chief Justice for misusing office
items.summary: Supreme Court Justice Sandeep Mehta has asked Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant to appoint a Chief Justice from another State to head the Rajasthan High Court "with immediate effect". In letters dated August 2, August 10 and August 17 accessed by Bar & Bench , Justice Mehta has accused acting Chief Justice Sanjeev Prakash Sharma of manipulating case listings in favour of rich litigants and misusing his administrative powers ahead of his retirement, due later next month. Justice Sharma was appointed as Rajasthan High Court judge in November 2016 and transferred to the Patna High Court in 2022. When he sought repatriation on health grounds, the Collegium headed by then Chief Justice of India DY Chandrachud declined the request in March 2023 and sent him instead to the Punjab and Haryana High Court. In May 2025, a fresh Collegium resolution recommended his return to Rajasthan. He went on to become the acting Chief Justice, a post Justice Mehta's letter says he has now held "for more than last 10 months." items.title: Patiala House court rejects Delhi Race Club's plea against order to vacate its Lutyens' Delhi premises
items.summary: A Delhi court on Tuesday refused to stay the government order of August 11 directing Delhi Race Club to vacate its Lutyens Delhi Premises in 15 days. Delhi Race Club is a century-old horse-racing institution located on Central Golf Link Road opposite the Prime Minister's official residence. Principal District & Sessions Judge (PDSJ) Pitamber Dutt of the Patiala House Courts dismissed the application filed by the Club seeking interim stay of the eviction order passed against it by the Estate Officer under the Public Premises (Eviction of Unauthorised Occupants) Act. “In view of the above facts and circumstances, I am of the considered view that appellant has failed to make a prima facie case for stay of the impugned order dated 11.08.2026 passed by the Ld. Estate Officer in case No.ESO/11/3(1)/2026 titled as Union of India Vs. Delhi Race Club. Accordingly, the application filed by the applicant/appellant for interim stay is dismissed,” the Court said. Appearing for the club, Senior Advocate Suhail Dutt had argued that the Estate Officer's order dated August 11 violated principles of natural justice, as the Club was not supplied a copy of the plaint despite repeated requests.
